items.review_rationale: Examined the whole local finiteness statement, including the point-specific open neighborhood and finite set of family indices meeting that neighborhood; not globally finite or merely point-finite.

references.context: Topology: open neighbourhood of a point in the given ambient topological space

references.disposition: Finiteness is for the index subset meeting the selected neighborhood, not for the full family.

items.review_rationale: Read all closure-compatible stratification conditions: locally closed partition, partial order on indices and downward closure compatibility; local finiteness is not a stated assumption.

references.context: Set theory: indexed union of strata over a down-set in a partially ordered index set

references.phrase: closure X_j lies in union of pieces i≤j
references.disposition: Direction of order and containment is part of the defining compatibility, not its converse.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed the full relative diagonal criterion and selected quasi-compactness of the diagonal as a scheme morphism; this is not the stronger closed immersion requirement.

references.context: Algebraic geometry: canonical diagonal of a scheme relative to a base scheme

references.disposition: The definition does not require closed immersion or separatedness.

items.review_rationale: Read both absolute separatedness and quasi-separatedness variants, each checked on the structure map to Spec(Z); distinguish properties of the scheme map from a Hausdorff condition on X.

references.context: Algebraic geometry: canonical map from any scheme to integer spectrum as base

references.disposition: Separatedness and quasi-separatedness are alternative criteria, not identical properties.
